title: Number of Recipients and Income Criteria for Silver Support Scheme
what_it_is: Number of Recipients and Income Criteria for Silver Support Scheme

sections.label: Silver Support payouts for elderly
sections.summary: Eligible elderly receive quarterly cash payouts of $300 to $750 based on their HDB flat type, with about 143,000 receiving payouts in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Eligible elderly receive cash payouts of between $300 and $750 every quarter, according to the type of HDB flat they live in.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The median quarterly payout has been $600, corresponding to the payout quantum for eligible elderly living in a 3-room HDB flat.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In 2016, about 143,000 elderly received Silver Support payouts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Of these elderly, 33,000 no longer received Silver Support in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: About 14,000 had passed away while 18,000 had seen their household incomes rise above the eligibility threshold.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: At the same time, 42,000 elderly who were not receiving Silver Support in 2016 were assessed to be eligible for Silver Support by 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Right now, the Silver Support total payouts annually is about more than $330 million.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Manpower (MOM) will review the Silver Support Scheme from time to time to ensure that it continues to provide meaningful support to the elderly who had low incomes throughout their lives and who now have little or no family support.
